title: writer hook: immutable decisions joined to measured cost revisions (PAPER / shadow only)

hooks.fires: after the engine has decided a candidate (taken | skipped | pending), at every existing _ml_decision call in the scan loop, independent of ML_SHADOW
hooks.copies: detached deep copies built on the engine thread; the hook never keeps a reference to engine objects

hooks.fires: only when a shadow producer exists; this slice has none, so zero shadow rows are written
when a taken decision's lot closes and actual_costs.row_view(row).status == 'measured' and actual_costs.measured(row).complete
hooks.copies: a plain dict of the five COST_REV_FIELDS read from the closed row, plus rev = row['cost_rev']

hooks.fires: after cost_rev is bumped on a closed row that already reached a measured outcome and is still measured and complete

decision_id.on_lot: lot['ml_decision_id'] stamped at engine.Engine._ml_link; the runtime slice widens the stamp condition to ML_SHADOW or AI_SCAN

join.latest: highest rev among a decision's measured revisions

never_gates.mechanism: the engine-thread hook only builds a sealed record inside try/except and offers it to a bounded, non-blocking queue; a dedicated writer daemon thread owns the scan ledger and does every disk write
never_gates.exceptions: every exception in the hook or the writer is counted and swallowed; none reaches order flow
never_gates.flag_read: S.get('AI_SCAN') is True, read at each call; anything else is off

paper_only.live_check: engine.live is True -> refused before any record is built; counted refused_live

identity.gate: same rule as ML-PAIR-01 identity_gap: non-dev build_id, 40-hex source_commit from the matching build.json, 64-hex bundle_hash

incomplete.signal: written with code_complete false; never eligible for fitting, calibration or pairing
incomplete.shadow: written with code_complete false; never verifies
incomplete.outcome: refused unwritten; counted identity_incomplete with identity_reason

failure_modes.effect: hook returns before building anything; ledger untouched

test_plan.name: test_flag_off_builds_and_writes_nothing
test_plan.asserts: AI_SCAN False: no hook builds a record, the ledger file is not created, counters stay zero

test_plan.name: test_live_mode_refused_before_build
test_plan.asserts: engine.live True with AI_SCAN True: refused_live counts, nothing built or written

test_plan.name: test_trading_byte_identical_with_ai_scan_on_off_and_failing_writer
test_plan.asserts: the same replayed PAPER cycle with AI_SCAN off, on, on with a raising writer, and on with a full queue yields byte-identical orders, history, state and log of order calls

test_plan.name: test_hook_never_raises_into_order_flow
test_plan.asserts: every builder and writer exception is counted in build_errors / write_errors and the cycle completes

test_plan.name: test_offer_never_blocks_when_queue_full_or_contended
test_plan.asserts: offer returns False within a bound; queue_full counts

test_plan.name: test_writer_never_holds_engine_lock
test_plan.asserts: the engine lock stays acquirable by the cycle while the writer is blocked on disk

test_plan.name: test_decision_hook_writes_one_signal_per_candidate
test_plan.asserts: each _ml_decision call yields one signal whose signal_id equals ml_shadow.ledger.decision_id, with or without ML_SHADOW

test_plan.name: test_measured_close_appends_outcome_keyed_by_cost_revision
test_plan.asserts: a measured, complete close of a taken decision appends one outcome with cost_revision_id computed from the payload and rev = cost_rev

test_plan.name: test_restatement_appends_new_revision_never_rewrites
test_plan.asserts: a _row_changed restatement appends a second outcome; the first line is byte-unchanged; fold picks the highest rev

test_plan.name: test_restart_replay_is_idempotent
test_plan.asserts: re-offering every record after a restart writes nothing and counts replays

test_plan.name: test_conflicting_replay_refused_unwritten
test_plan.asserts: same record key, different record_hash: refused, conflicts counts, file bytes unchanged

test_plan.name: test_same_rev_two_costs_refused
test_plan.asserts: two cost revisions sharing one rev: the second is refused and counted ambiguous_rev

test_plan.name: test_booked_acknowledged_pending_never_measured
test_plan.asserts: booked, acknowledged, pending and incomplete closes produce no outcome and count non_measured_close / cost_incomplete

test_plan.name: test_outcome_only_for_taken_decisions
test_plan.asserts: skipped and pending decisions get no measured outcome; not_taken counts

test_plan.name: test_incomplete_identity_refuses_outcome_flags_signal
test_plan.asserts: dev build, missing source_commit or bundle_hash: outcome refused with identity_reason, signal written with code_complete false

test_plan.name: test_cost_identity_matches_ml_pair_01
test_plan.asserts: for the same close, ai_scan cost_revision_id equals ml_shadow.pairs cost_revision_id and signal_id equals the pair decision_id (enabled once #226 merges)

test_plan.name: test_no_model_or_network_call
test_plan.asserts: with sockets and the anthropic client patched to raise, every hook path completes and nothing is called

test_plan.name: test_api_view_unchanged_shape
test_plan.asserts: GET /api/ai_scan returns ai_scan.api_off() when off and only ledger rows when on; no settings or engine state mutated

open_questions: Should the decision-id stamp on the lot be widened to ML_SHADOW or AI_SCAN, or should AI_SCAN require ML_SHADOW on?
ai_scan.COST_BASES['measured'] still admits net basis 'booked'; should the runtime slice narrow it to 'measured' (this contract filters at the hook)?
ML-PAIR-01 pairs only at the first measured close; should it also pair restatements from _row_changed so both stores carry the same revisions?
Identity on records needs ai-scan-schema-v2; acceptable, or should identity live in a once-written ledger epoch file like pair_epoch.json?
Dedicated AI-SCAN writer thread, or a new row kind on the existing ml_shadow LedgerWriter?
